purpose: third independent cross-material test after freezing the adaptive-rank and analytic-q representation on VSe2 and testing it on TaS2
data_policy: use the existing remote EPW/Wannier asset; do not launch new DFT or add q labels after seeing holdout errors

mode.tracking: maximum eigenvector overlap followed by phase alignment

model.latent_q_representation: degree-4 Chebyshev polynomial fitted only to the five training q points

metadata_policy: file names, stored Fermi level, and EPW mesh dimensions may be read from the archived calculation because they are input metadata rather than fitted model choices
not_part_of_this_gate: absolute agreement of the stored EPW spectrum with converged DFT
post-hoc rank, polynomial degree, or label-count changes
